description: Rules of Action Conditions & Materialization: In the post-war ruins of the Broken Covenant, resolving existential crises incurs unavoidable moral and biological costs. Every path demands sacrifice.

materialization_laws.conservation_of_dissonance: Suppressing trauma with logic increases neural strain; embracing organic purity limits technological capability; biological grafting invites silicon rot.
materialization_laws.tragic_tradeoff_principle: No action is universally beneficial. Gaining faction trust or resources permanently expends agency or vital stats.
materialization_laws.unaligned_discernment: The fourth path avoids dogmatic extremes but requires rigorous clarity and psychological fortitude.

action_scavenge_relay_core.name: Scavenge Sub-Processor Relay Core
action_scavenge_relay_core.description: Extract a dormant logic core from feral drone wrecks in dangerous ruins.

trade_offs.faction_consequence: Iron Consensus monitors flag unauthorized recovery

action_scavenge_relay_core.consequence_on_completion: Yields high-grade machine processing units at the expense of acute nervous system fatigue and tracker exposure.

action_emp_purge_terminal.name: Detonate EMP Surge on Surveillance Node
action_emp_purge_terminal.description: Trigger an electrostatic pulse discharge to black out a regional Consensus surveillance terminal.

trade_offs.collateral_damage: Fries nearby civilian medical implants and unshielded diagnostic pads

action_emp_purge_terminal.consequence_on_completion: Blinds local automated sweep squad sensors, but permanently damages delicate cybernetics in the vicinity.

action_harmonic_broadcast_sync.name: Broadcast Harmonic Consensus Override
action_harmonic_broadcast_sync.description: Interface directly with the Iron Consensus telemetry array to reroute logistics drones.

trade_offs.faction_consequence: Deepens cognitive subservience to hive logic algorithms

action_harmonic_broadcast_sync.consequence_on_completion: Unlocks automated supply caches while eroding individual sovereign volition.

action_synthesize_organ_graft.name: Implant Synergist Biomechanical Organ Graft
action_synthesize_organ_graft.description: Surgically fuse salvage warmachine actuators with living tissue in the Chimera Foundry.

trade_offs.faction_consequence: Branded an abomination by the Ashen Genesis Purifiers

action_synthesize_organ_graft.consequence_on_completion: Grants immense kinetic power and environmental shielding while permanently compromising baseline human genetics.

action_observe_unaligned_path.name: Synthesize Unaligned Diagnostic Reality Path
action_observe_unaligned_path.description: Analyze conflicting telemetry between ideological factions to chart a third/fourth course through the crisis.

trade_offs.isolation_cost: Distrusted by both Consensus drones and Purifier zealots

action_observe_unaligned_path.consequence_on_completion: Illuminates hidden alternatives without submitting to dogma, bearing the burden of solitary survival.
